title.zh: 户外婚礼花艺装置设计方案

description.zh: 香槟黄与米白布帘交叠。
木框承接错落的簇生花艺。
description.en: Timber frames carry loose floral clusters.

description.zh: 橙色纸花点亮草坪仪式区。
description.en: Orange paper flowers accent the lawn ceremony.

medium.zh: 浅米水彩纸，细针管笔轮廓与柔和水彩晕染，标题有手写笔锋
medium.en: Warm ivory watercolor paper, fine pen outlines, gentle washes and a brush-lettered title

layout.zh: 标题靠顶，主图占上半幅，左说明右引线；下区左侧两行小图，右侧纵列细节，底部横排样块
layout.en: Top title and a large upper hero, with a left note and right leaders; two rows of small views below left, stacked details below right and swatches along the bottom

setting.zh: 草坪边缘，背景为较疏的乔灌木
setting.en: A lawn edge with open trees and shrubs in the background

zone.zh: 户外仪式区，木框装置面向座席与入场通道
zone.en: An outdoor ceremony installation facing guest seating and the approach aisle

time_and_lighting.zh: 明亮的漫射自然日光，地面有浅淡的软影
time_and_lighting.en: Bright diffused daylight and soft ground shadows

type.zh: 由左低、中高、右次高木框组成的错层门架
type.en: Staggered timber portals with a low left bay, tall central bay and mid-height right bay

material.zh: 自然棕色木框与低矮灰色底座
material.en: Natural brown timber with low gray plinths

components.zh: 竖向立柱与阶梯状横梁
有落地接触的低矮块状底座
components.en: Low plinth blocks with visible ground contact

components.zh: 中央横梁和右框顶部作为布艺挂点
components.en: The central beam and right portal top as fabric attachment points

foliage.en: dark trailing greenery and sparse fine grasses

form.zh: 有疏有密的自然团簇，结合枝叶垂坠与细长花序
form.en: Loose layered clusters with hanging greenery and slender upright spikes

placement.zh: 主花团集中在中高框上端和左中节点，底部花簇从右框脚沿通道边缘向前延伸
placement.en: Major clusters sit at the tall center top and left-center joint. Low clusters extend from the right post along the aisle edge

colors.zh: 黄、米白为主，蓝紫、橙和深绿为补色
colors.en: yellow and cream, accented by blue-violet, orange and deep green

type.en: Light semitransparent fabric and soft drapery

drape.zh: 左侧呈浅 U 形，中央长弧跨过花团下方，右端近竖垂
drape.en: A shallow U on the left, a longer central sweep below the flowers and a near-vertical fall at the right

fixing_points.zh: 左低梁端与中央高梁附近
fixing_points.en: the left low beam end and near the central tall beam
the top of the right portal

focal_elements.zh: 中右高处的两朵橙黄大纸艺花，右柱有一朵较小纸花呼应
focal_elements.en: Two large yellow-orange paper flowers at upper center-right and a smaller echo on the far-right post

furniture_props.zh: 入场通道两边的实木交叉背椅，椅背有浅色纱饰
furniture_props.en: Timber cross-back chairs lining the aisle, with pale fabric on the backs

target.zh: 中央木梁与立柱的相接处
target.en: junction of the central beam and post
the vertical ivory drape on the right

target.zh: 中右高处最显眼的橙黄纸花
target.en: large orange-yellow paper blossom at upper center-right

target.zh: 右侧低位黄白与蓝紫混合花团
target.en: low mixed yellow, white and violet flower cluster at right

content.zh: 保留左右高低错层，纸花在高框右侧，黄布弧线偏左和中央
content.en: Show the stepped bays, paper flowers at the tall bay’s right and yellow drape arcs across the left and center

content.zh: 以右侧为观察方向，显示立柱、近竖布帘及基座附近地面花团
content.en: Look from the right to show the post, near-vertical fabric and low flowers at the plinth

content.zh: 从上方标出横梁、两端落地接触、布弧和右端低花团的投影
content.en: Show overhead footprints of beams, ground contacts, drape arcs and the low right flower groups

content.zh: 沿装配方向分离木框、布艺、上方花团和低底座，保持左右关系
content.en: Separate timber, drapery, top florals and low plinths along assembly directions while keeping left/right relationships

subject.zh: 浅黄纱在木梁附近的薄折与垂弧
subject.en: thin folds and the curve of pale fabric beside a timber beam

lines.en: The fabric falls in a soft curve.

subject.zh: 橙黄纸花的卷边折瓣与花心
subject.en: curled orange-yellow paper petals and the flower center

lines.en: Curled rims radiate from the center.

subject.zh: 黄、白、蓝花序与叶材的层次
subject.en: layers of yellow, white and blue blooms and foliage

subject.zh: 木柱底部与灰色块面及草坪的关系
subject.en: the timber upright meeting a gray block at lawn level

lines.en: The timber rests on a low gray plinth.
Show the connection at ground level.

reason.zh: 使用黄金版式的示例量级，数值仅用于概念展示。
reason.en: Concept estimates chosen at the scale of the illustrative layout.

reason.zh: 挂点位置由布幅走向推断，连接件尚未核实。
reason.en: Fixing locations follow the drape path. Hardware is unverified.
